request.query: Multivariate polynomial diagonal substitution equals sum of monomials indexed by total degree

items.name: MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_apply
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) φ =
    ∑ d ∈ φ.support with Finsupp.degree d = n, (MvPolynomial.monomial d) (MvPolynomial.coeff d φ)

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (φ.totalDegree + 1), (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent i) φ = φ

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPowerSeries.subst_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
      MvPowerSeries.subst a ((MvPowerSeries.monomial e) r) =
        (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S)) r * e.prod fun s n => a s ^ n

items.name: MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)
